reviews.decision_reason: The function preserves all eight supplied demand records for this input because every record has demand_score >= 3. The assigned output contains the same eight needs with the same record_id, need, demand_score, source_id, and source_weight values, supporting the downstream handoff.

The function normalizes the expected columns and retains exactly the allowed record ids. For the supplied input, the assigned output shows all eight normalized needs retained without altered market-demand fields.

The function assembles provenance from the normalized needs and ranks records deterministically by descending demand_score, then record_id. The evidence_sources handoff in the assigned output matches the expected eight records and ranks used by the downstream final output.
